candidates.defline: Opportunity sits in your spouse palace: your intimate life keeps a horizon in it.
candidates.reading: This position rules Love and Social, with Wealth in the walls. Attraction, for you, wears novelty: charm, motion, people with their own passports. Settling reads as a risk rather than a relief, so partnership must be built as a shared expedition or it suffocates. Money flows around your love life, gifts, ventures, rescues. Choose a partner who loves the journey but audits the map. Romance survives adventure. It rarely survives vagueness.
